# Nullary binary method formals

Independently authored Java8 methods return one method-owned Object formal in
both invariant slots of a complete binary interface. A static factory shadows
one of its declaring interface's two class formals. The frozen observer checks
opaque results, original provider effects, delayed casts, callback dispatch,
nulls, exact failures and ignored results. Actual JDK Function.identity calls
check the matching standard declaration without executing private application
code. Every recovered unit compiles in source and SDK modes; original metadata,
method roles, Exceptions and reported helpers are compared independently.
